title: Man. Post. Cap. IX: PLAC tip — if actual, Apostle omitted inhering or hid it under death
pass_a_gloss: Finally: if the sin that entered means Adam's actual, Paul must either have wholly omitted inhering corruption or have packed it under the name of death. Both are false; therefore so is that. Tip before working the two falsehoods.
pass_b_english: Finally if by the sin which entered into the world Adam's actual sin is understood, it is necessary that the Apostle either wholly omitted inhering corruption, or comprehended it under the name of death. Both of these are false; Therefore that also.
source_text: Denique si per peccatum quod in mundum introiit, peccatum actuale Adami intelligitur, necesse est, ut Apostolus, vel prorsus omiserit corruptionem inhaerentem, vel eam mortis nomine comprehenderit. Hoc utrumque est falsum; Ergo & illud.

choices.choice: If actual, omit inhering or pack under death—both false; tip

notes: Cap. IX senses densify section 526 from locked 1661 Latin (pp. 328–329 tip).
